title: atractylodes chinensis var. liaotungensis
intro: Atractylodes chinensis var. liaotungensis, commonly known as White Atractylodes, is a variety of the Atractylodes plant, a type of sarsaparilla plant in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat a variety of ailments, including digestive issues and fever, due to its health benefits in promoting digestion, reducing inflammation, and enhancing immune function. The therapeutic actions of White Atractylodes include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of White Atractylodes include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
